\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 241-244 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R249-first-pass-words-from-chapters-241-244}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for congratulations and a cooking pot.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item polite, patient, modest, funny, serious
  \item noisy, dead, wild, tame, poisonous
  \item lukewarm, annoying, frightening, second-hand, fake
  \item yoghurt, peaches, pears, pineapple, almonds
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Polite? (\textbf{\ar{مهذب}}, \emph{muhadhdhab}.) Patient? (\textbf{\ar{صبور}}, \emph{ṣabūr}.) Modest? (\textbf{\ar{متواضع}}, \emph{mutawāḍiʿ}.) Funny? (\textbf{\ar{مضحك}}, \emph{muḍḥik}.) Serious? (\textbf{\ar{جاد}}, \emph{jādd}.) Noisy? (\textbf{\ar{صاخب}}, \emph{ṣākhib}.) Dead? (\textbf{\ar{ميت}}, \emph{mayyit}.) Wild? (\textbf{\ar{بري}}, \emph{barrī}.) Tame? (\textbf{\ar{أليف}}, \emph{alīf}.) Poisonous? (\textbf{\ar{سام}}, \emph{sāmm}.) Lukewarm? (\textbf{\ar{فاتر}}, \emph{fātir}.) Annoying? (\textbf{\ar{مزعج}}, \emph{muzʿij}.) Frightening? (\textbf{\ar{مخيف}}, \emph{mukhīf}.) Second-hand? (\textbf{\ar{مستعمل}}, \emph{mustaʿmal}.) Fake? (\textbf{\ar{مزيف}}, \emph{muzayyaf}.) Yoghurt? (\textbf{\ar{زبادي}}, \emph{zabādī}.) Peaches? (\textbf{\ar{خوخ}}, \emph{khawkh}.) Pears? (\textbf{\ar{كمثرى}}, \emph{kummathrā}.) Pineapple? (\textbf{\ar{أناناس}}, \emph{anānās}.) Almonds? (\textbf{\ar{لوز}}, \emph{lawz}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 245-249 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R249-second-pass-words-from-chapters-245-249}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a necklace and a size.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a necklace, a size, a telephone, a mobile phone, a screen
  \item a family, a grandson, an aunt, a twin, a bridegroom
  \item air, a wave, roses, a palm tree, jasmine
  \item the internet, a website, an app, a device, a TV series
  \item a quantity, quality, a celebration, congratulations, a cooking pot
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A necklace? (\textbf{\ar{قلادة}}, \emph{qilāda}.) A size? (\textbf{\ar{مقاس}}, \emph{maqās}.) A telephone? (\textbf{\ar{هاتف}}, \emph{hātif}.) A mobile phone? (\textbf{\ar{جوال}}, \emph{jawwāl}.) A screen? (\textbf{\ar{شاشة}}, \emph{shāsha}.) A family? (\textbf{\ar{أسرة}}, \emph{usra}.) A grandson? (\textbf{\ar{حفيد}}, \emph{ḥafīd}.) An aunt? (\textbf{\ar{عمة}}, \emph{ʿamma}.) A twin? (\textbf{\ar{توأم}}, \emph{tawʾam}.) A bridegroom? (\textbf{\ar{عريس}}, \emph{ʿarīs}.) Air? (\textbf{\ar{هواء}}, \emph{hawāʾ}.) A wave? (\textbf{\ar{موجة}}, \emph{mawja}.) Roses? (\textbf{\ar{ورد}}, \emph{ward}.) A palm tree? (\textbf{\ar{نخلة}}, \emph{nakhla}.) Jasmine? (\textbf{\ar{ياسمين}}, \emph{yāsamīn}.) The internet? (\textbf{\ar{إنترنت}}, \emph{intarnit}.) A website? (\textbf{\ar{موقع}}, \emph{mawqiʿ}.) An app? (\textbf{\ar{تطبيق}}, \emph{taṭbīq}.) A device? (\textbf{\ar{جهاز}}, \emph{jihāz}.) A TV series? (\textbf{\ar{مسلسل}}, \emph{musalsal}.) A quantity? (\textbf{\ar{كمية}}, \emph{kammiyya}.) Quality? (\textbf{\ar{جودة}}, \emph{jawda}.) A celebration? (\textbf{\ar{احتفال}}, \emph{iḥtifāl}.) Congratulations? (\textbf{\ar{مبروك}}, \emph{mabrūk}.) A cooking pot? (\textbf{\ar{طنجرة}}, \emph{ṭanjara}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
